title: The benchmark suite has a row with a query length cap
body:
The suite on branch `bench` runs four rows: normal, long-n, protein and long-repeats, all without `--max-query-len`. A query length cap is a first-class feature, and a change to the sort can move a capped build while the four rows stay flat. The floor for `merge_sort` in sufr-1422ef did exactly that on 2026-11-05: 1.21 to 1.15 s on `dna-100.fa` with `--dna -m 20`, timed by hand, with the suite showing nothing.

## Proposal

A fifth row, the normal DNA fixture with `--dna -m 20`, so a capped build is on every board.
